title: Prioritize & deduplicate
summary: Rank consequences and change exposure rather than precise-looking guessed scores.

sections.label: Assessment dimensions
items: Consequence for users or domain correctness.
Frequency of changes in the affected area.

sections.label: Ticket discipline
sections.text: Cluster duplicate findings, inspect root causes, and have an owner triage before creating many tickets. One root cause may explain several warnings.

sections.label: Acceptance
sections.text: Priority explains why this outcome is worth addressing now. Estimates disclose uncertainty and do not pretend Sonar costs equal delivery effort.

sections.label: Gap review: workflow use and checks
items: Recommended workflow steps: Compare feasible approaches, Recommend go or no-go, Stories and delivery plan. These links are recommendations based on the guide content, not required product or process choices.
A triage table links each candidate to user consequence, exposure, change frequency, evidence strength and an accountable owner.
The decision explains why the selected outcome is worth doing now, documents duplicates and dependencies, and keeps estimates distinct from measurements.
Each accepted priority has a bounded next action and an acceptance check. Unsupported rankings remain provisional.

Only the added source contribution was fact checked in this pass. Earlier statements retain their original basis and confidence. Project configuration, usefulness and actual check outcomes remain unverified.

sections.label: Gap review: verified source contribution
sections.text: The SEI debt analytics project describes consolidating candidate items and forming an initial ranking from defects, change and bug churn with causal analysis. The assessment dimensions here are a proposed decision aid. The source does not prescribe their weights or make an automatic priority decision. Checked against the linked primary source on 2026-10-15. This review covers this contribution only.

catalog.applicability: Use when many findings or warnings have been collected and you must decide which deserve tickets now. It ranks by consequence and change exposure, clusters duplicates by root cause and keeps estimate uncertainty visible.
catalog.limits: Reading a topic does not configure tools, execute a workflow or establish passing evidence.
